The molecule likely is aspirin? Aspirin is acetylsalicylic acid: C9H8O4, aromatic ring with one methyl (acetyl) and one carboxylic acid. SMILES for aspirin: "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O". Let's verify fragments: aromatic ring c1ccccc1, attached to O-COCH3 (acetoxy) and COOH. The fragment 'OC(=O)C' corresponds to O-C(=O)-C (acetoxy). 'C(=O)O' is carboxylic acid. So SMILES: "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O". That matches formula C9H8O4. So answer.
